title: Appeals and Grievances Clause Sheet: Payment a Joining TRICARE Select Inpatient Line Would Carry
content:
Appeals and Grievances clause sheet — payment the joining line would carry

For a further paid TRICARE Select inpatient line joining the Allowable Charge Review already filed on its claim.

The payment the joining line would carry is figured by one of three methods: where the other insurer's payment counted is at least the allowed amount, no payment would be made; where a payment by another insurer below the allowed amount is counted, the cost share is figured on the allowed amount less that payment and the payment is that net amount less the cost share, rounded to the cent; in every other case the cost share is figured on the allowed amount itself and the payment is the allowed amount less the cost share, rounded to the cent.

The allowed amount here is the allowed amount claimed on the joining line; the tier whose schedule figures apply is the tier of the TRICARE Select enrollment the joining line was billed under.

| Payment counted from another insurer | Method |
|---|---|
| at least the allowed amount | no payment would be made |
| above zero and below the allowed amount | cost share on the allowed amount less that payment; payment is that net amount less the cost share |
| none | cost share on the allowed amount; payment is the allowed amount less the cost share |

Hypothetical: allowed amount claimed 4,620.00; the cost share figured on it comes to 1,250.00 under a daily-charge basis.

| Other insurer's payment counted | Figured on | Payment |
|---|---|---|
| 5,000.00 | — | none: the payment counted is at least the allowed amount |
| 4,620.00 | — | none: equal to the allowed amount |
| 600.00 | 4,020.00 | 4,020.00 less 1,250.00, which is 2,770.00 |
| none | 4,620.00 | 4,620.00 less 1,250.00, which is 3,370.00 |
